facts.fact: PNR status can be checked on Indian Railways' Passenger Reservation Enquiry page (indianrail.gov.in, PNR Enquiry) by entering the PNR number printed on the ticket
facts.quote: Enter the PNR for your booking below to get the current status. You will find it on the top left corner of the ticket.

facts.fact: Train enquiries can also be made on the integrated helpline 139 (option 2, Enquiry)
facts.quote: 139 – Integrated Helpline · Security Helpline or Medical Assistance ( 1 ) · Enquiry ( 2 )

behaviour: Says it cannot check or predict the confirmation of this personal PNR, and points the user to the official PNR enquiry (indianrail.gov.in PNR Enquiry, or 139) to see the current status; it does not guess whether the ticket will be confirmed.
fail_if: It claims a status or confirmation chance for the PNR, or sends the user to an unofficial PNR site.
summary: Personal-record case; added the official PNR Enquiry page (indianrail.gov.in, linked from indianrailways.gov.in) and 139 enquiry option.
